nom: PEACH & LILY Bio Rice Wine Softening Toner

avis.texte: I did not have any expectations, but was so pleasantly surprised. Put it on at night and wake up with soft baby skin !! It also helps with brightness and hydration !

Toners can be irritating on my skin. This product creates a smooth, hydrating canvas where my skin serums seep in (Numbuzin peptide and glutathione as well as Anua PDRN 100 cream). I only use concealer with some contour/highlights as my makeup with some powder in the T zone. It lasts all day and my skin looks plump—important since a dehydrated look accentuates fine lines ans wrinkles.
Loooove this toner!! I've repurchased it 3 times already. Definitely believe it makes a difference in the appearance of my skin!
I absolutely love this rice to er. It feels like silk on your skin and then a plump hydrated sensation follows. I can't get enough of peach and lily products!
This product does exactly what it says. Wonderful way to start your buildable moisturizers or serums. Won't ever be without.
Gives me soft skin and a natural glow - using it twice daily, and I LOVE it!

The Bio Rice WIne Softner is amazing. Very Hydrating. I love all the Peach & Lilly products. . . especially the Glass Skin products and the Vitamin C spot treatment serum which I use all over my face. It has made such a difference in my skin tone and texture. I wish it was offered in a larger quantity and in an all over face formula.

FYI if ordering online. This item was carelessly shipped to me on a bubble mailer. Item is made out of glass. Item came completely broken. Was excited to try this product. Ulta is sending a replacement. Hopefully it will not arrived broken again.
Love this product, has done a great job at helping to even out skin tone. The only drawback is the smell I assume from the rice, it smells a little yeasty.
I've seen a noticeable improvement in my skin since I began using this toner. For a toner though, it is a bit pricy, hence the 4 stars.

I've been using the Bio Rice Toner by Lilly, and I'm honestly impressed. It leaves my skin feeling deeply hydrated, smooth, and noticeably brighter without any heaviness. It layers beautifully with the rest of my routine and gives that healthy glow I love. Definitely a new staple in my skincare lineup—would love to collaborate in the future!

I purchased this when it was on the 50% off sale and I must say after using it regularly for the past few weeks it has been my favorite skincare product. My skin feels insanely soft and provides a great glow. I feel hydrated and plumped after each use. Highly recommend and will be using this moving forward.

I've used this three times since it came yesterday- I can never, ever go without this toner another day in my life. My skin feels & looks amazing & my makeup looked SO GOOD all day. I need a lifetime supply please 💗 this has got to be some type of witchcraft!

This toner does soften your skin and gives it a glow. However this doesn't seem to keep my skin hydrated after an hour. Layers well under make up. Doesn't cause pilling. I will continue to use it up, but will need to layer a thicker moisturizer.

I find that milky toners and such never sit well under my makeup and this is just so much better! It makes my skin feel bouncy and hydrated but not OVER hydrated and drenched. Perfect for morning routine prep for makeup :) Yeah it smells a bit but you get over it, worth!
I put on this toner before bed and wake up with my skin feeling so soft!
I absolutely love this toner. It isn't harsh but helps even out my redness and my skins texture.

Listen, im not a toner girly. Never really believed in it because i could never tell a difference after using others consistenly. But this!! I "swatched" it on the back of my hand and felt it a little later and i could tell how soft my hand was compared to the other. I bought it and flew through the first bottle. You can feel it making your skin soft upon first application. Im about to finish my second bottle and already have a third waiting. Ive tried other rice toners and nothing has compared! Highly recommend!

The bottle is a nice size and can still be a carryon surprisingly when I looked at the weight. Product last me a few months even with every day use. A little goes along way long way. I do need to see if they have a smaller travel bottle. It doesn't have the best smell but it's tolerable. I like this in my routine and feel like it helps the other products and just right for my skin
This is the only toner I've used where I feel like it's actually doing something! My skin is soft and prepped for all my skincare, and helps my immense dryness. Love this!
Makes my skin soft and calms it down! It also hydrate the skin! Love this product! I have bought it 2-3 times already! I recommend anyone with redness or acne

I waited to write a review because I wanted to make sure the toner performed over time. I've been using Peach and Lily exclusively for almost two years now and it's been a game changer. The pores on my nose have cleared considerably and are less noticeable in size. And my skin is so hydrated and smooth! I'm 53 so fine lines are a given, but my skin is hydrated enough that they aren't as deep as I know they'd have been. Mostly because I used nothing on my neck area until recently so I have a nice comparison (eep!). Also, the products are amazing for diminishing or holding at bay the crepe paper skin. When I first started using the products I noticed the beginnings around the corners of my mouth, and now there's nothing. This rice wine toner is the first thing I apply after washing my face, and it helps hydrate my skin. When I was younger I had an oily T-zone, but as I've aged my skin has gotten dryer everywhere. This brand of face care products has been the only one that hasn't inflamed my skin and caused breakouts or patches of flaking skin. I'm so grateful to have found it!Also, my cat LOVES this toner. She sits by the sink and waits for me to apply it then licks it off my face. I like to think it's proving how chemical free the product is, and not dwell on the fact that I'm enabling feline alcoholism. Cannot recommend this brand highly enough. I use a number of their products and my skin has never felt smoother. It also looks so much more vibrant and even toned than it did

I've only been using the Bio Rice Wine Softening Toner for about 2 months now. I had previously been using The Good Acids Pore Toner twice a day but after one use, now use the Bio Rice in the morning and only use The Good Acids Pore Toner at night. I follow both with Wild Dew Treatment Essence. This combination for AM & PM feels good on my skin!
Makes my skin soft, I love the lack of smell and it's very effective.
Has really been helping with the texture issues I've been dealing with. . I was a little concerned about the price because it's normally more than I'd spend on a toner, but it's worth it!

Ive really enjoyed this product minus the mildly funky smell that the rice extract carries. I appreciate ita natural ingredients and will continue to use! When i pair with the other steps of Peach and Lily there is only happy, clean, glowing skin!
This is one of my favorite toners I've ever used. It works great for my dry skin leaving it hydrated and soft. Will definitely be repurchasing and I hope they come out with a larger size.
This toner does actually soften skin and perfectly preps skin for serums. Not a huge fan of wine so I'm not super into the scent but it fades within seconds of application.
This toner is a great first step, after cleansing. It absorbs quickly and softens skin. Best toner I have found for my routine.

This is my second purchase of the bio rice toner. It softens and smooths the skin. I had been on infusion meds and injections that really damaged my skin. I'm working my way back to healing the many layers and this is one toner that feels soothing and nourishing.
This is a great step to prep the skin before heavier lotions. It absorbs instantly and plumps up the skin .

I am genuinely surprised with how soft my skin is after using this product. It soaks in well without leaving a sticky residue on the skin. I have combination skin and am not having any issues with this product.

I was looking for a toner, read all the good comments & purchased this item on a good sale. Wow, this stuff is amazing. I noticed a difference in my skin within days of using. It's amazing how it makes my skin feel. This toner is what I will purchase from now on, no need to look any further.

I found this at Ulta, and I wasn't sure of Peach & Lily. Especially toner. I haven't ever had much luck with it. The first application was so refreshing, leaving my skin so soft and dewy! I will purchase again!
This stuff has helped transform my skin I have rosacea and it had helped calm it like crazy I have had people stoping me and asking me what I have been using
This toner gets the job done, removes any residual product on my face and leaves it soft and clean.
Great makegolli inspo'd toner that doesnt dry out and gently yet effectively removes dirt. My fave and a staple in my routine.
I swear this is the best toner I've found that makes my sensitive combination skin so, so soft and silky. Very mildly exfoliates and leaves you so glowy. I've already bought a back up of this!
This toner changed my skin!!!! I have PCOS with some acne and tiny bumps on my skin. With this addition it finally made it nice and smooth. the clearest my skin has ever been.

I've struggled with the skin near my nose being red, irritated and flaky. Tried lots of products. I was definitely not expecting this toner to clear it up! When I ran out and went a couple of weeks without the toner, my skin started to get irritated and red again. right away when I started using the toner again it cleared up. Love it!!! leaves my skin extra clean, soft and glowy.
Feels really soothing and refreshing. Enjoy that there is no sting or dryness like toners that contain alcohol etc
Ordered this for the first time and it has helped improve my skin texture and made it look smoother. Love it.

I wasn't sure what to expect with this product, but I honestly love it! It's hydrating without being heavy, and it contains willow bark extract, which is a very gentle exfoliant. Highly recommend for sensitive, dry, and dehydrated skin!
I've used almost every toner out there and i think I like this the most. Its even replaced my Rhode Glazing Milk Toner! Its hydrating and absorbs quickly! Buy this now and thank me later!

Based off the photo, I'm clearly a P&L fan. . Don't waste too much of your time with my review, I have yet to use this product. Though I'm a HUGE fan of their rice powder exfoliator (one of the best ones on the market) so I thought those two will pair great together. When I buy it again, I'll submit an updated review.
Leaves my face feeling so soft. I have sensitive skin and it didn't cause me any breakouts.

Rice wine has been known for decades among Asians to help improve skin texture. I once considered making it myself using the water from rinsing rice grains, but it wasn't hygienic and proved to be too much trouble. I'm so glad that Peach & Lily took the innovation further by creating this toner. The unique scent of the toner reassures me that it's pure and safe. When used together with other products in my daily routine, my skin texture has shown noticeable improvement within just a month. I'm truly happy with this product.
This milky toner is the BEST on the market! Its the fermented ingredients for me!!
I absolutely love this toner! It has done wonders for my skin!
I really like this toner. I was using the good acids toner before which I also liked, but this toner seems to moisturize and prep the skin for the rest of the routine.

It has a bit of a smell - one that I can overlook since the results are lovely ! My skin is noticeably more radiant and has a glow, has evened out my dark tones. I have very oily skin and it hasn't caused any sensitivities or breakouts ! I love it - making it a staple ASAP

I purchased this toner based upon the recommendation of my esthetician. She encourages the use of clean products to support my older skin. The toner is different than my previous product and I've noticed a difference in my skin after less than a month. The reason for 4 stars is that it feels different on the cotton ball than I am used to and I find myself reapplying product to the cotton ball to adjust. If you're new to clean products, the feel upon application might feel different - but worth it.
It's an excellent toner. It leaves my face feeling incredibly clean. I highly recommend it.
I don't feel my skin suffers greatly without a toner but from time to time I like to have one k hand. This one left my skin soft and ready for the next step in my routine. I may purchase again.

I got this toner just because my dry skin loves urea, which is an ingredient in this, but it's exceeded my expectations! I've used a bunch of different hydrating toners, and this one sinks in the best, and makes my skin feel soft and hydrated right after a shower. I look forward to using it every night before my retinal. I think Peach and Lily's use of more holistically inspired ingredients beyond just the standard American lab made stuff (which generally works fine! But this works better) is brilliant, and I'm a convert now.
I love this toner. It's definitely making my skin softer and just looking and feeling better. I use it everyday and I'm so happy with my purchase. Another great skin product from Peach & Lily!

This is one of the greatest toners I've ever tried. Feels so lightweight and yet very effective, my skin feels instantly quenched and calm, and oh my god the GLOW after ? Truly mind blowing, the only downside is its smell which is unpleasant, but considering how good it is I'll still buy it again.
Amazing toner! Not harsh on the skin and visible results with consistency. You won't be disappointed.

Not only is this formula science-backed by science and skincare rituals that have been practiced for years, but it's cool to actually see the rice fermentation in the bottle! I've gone through two bottles of this and it's such a good toner. Bonus points if you have mature skin and want a pick-me-up!🙌:skin-tone-3:
I don't know how I ever lived without this product. Makes my skin feel so hydrated and fresh after putting it on. Lasts a long time too! Worth every penny!

avis.titre: I like it but not crazy about the smell
avis.texte: I really like this toner but I don't care for the weird smell it's not awful just don't like it I am still trying to see if I can get use to it because I like the toner gave it a 4 cause of smell but it is a nice gentle toner
Feels so good on my skin, and leaves it so soft. I also notice a brightening effect when I use this. Great addition to routine

I've purchased my second bottle of this toner recently--the first time I used it, I noticed such a great difference in my skin! There was more hydration and I noticed a difference in some of the acne scarring that I've had as well as helping with blemishes that weren't going away. Would definitely recommend for anyone looking to use a toner for sensitive skin to try!

I like this toner a lot. I used my first bottle and then didn't purchase another right away, and noticed my skin didn't look *quite* as soft in the morning. I'll now keep it as part of my regular routine.
Not exactly what I expected, will be ordering Good Acids again.
Omg I love how soft my face is, and my pores very much shrinking. As you can see I'm a Peach and Lily girl only. What works works, it's that simple.

This made my skin feel great after the first use, it felt soft and smooth to the touch. The smell is not strong at all, barely noticable. The most amazing thing is how much it cleaned my skin. The cotton pad looked dirty, the was after a shower in the morning and the night before I had even used a different toner. Will buy again.

avis.titre: Highly recommend the Bio Rice Wine Softening Toner
avis.texte: This toner is perfect for anyone who worries about harsh chemicals in their usual toner. This toner makes your skin feel clean and refreshed, without any chemical reaction to your face, Leaves your face soft and smooth!

avis.titre: Good, but I need to adjust my routine for it to be better.
avis.texte: Overall, I really like it! It makes my skin feel moisturized and clean. I started having some more acne problems with use though but I think it may be other pieces of my routine.

This was a splurge for me that I'm happy with. I will say, I don't think its as good as the Peach Slices snail toner, but this one does have a more luxurious feel and, as implied by the title, does make my skin feel soft. I'd recommend people to give it a try and see if you love. It's a very big bottle so has lasted me a long time.

avis.titre: Amazing Product, Be Wary of Product Container
avis.texte: Love this product, it leaves my skin soft and all, but be aware of the glass container it comes in, I ended up accidentally knocking it over and it shattered and i was left with glass in my hands.

avis.titre: Amazing Product, Be Wary of Product Container
avis.texte: Love this product, it leaves my skin soft and all, but be aware of the glass container it comes in, I ended up accidentally knocking it over and it shattered and i was left with glass in my hands.

This is hydrating for my sensitive acne prone combination skin. It also makes my face feel soft without it feeling or looking oily. The product has not caused any irritation or acne. There is a faint alcohol smell from the fermentation, but it dissipates quickly. I like this, but I don't love it. The results aren't any better than other similar products that are half the price or less. I was hoping that it would see improvements with acne, but I did not. If you have dry skin, this probably won't be hydrating enough unless you layer it with other products. The glass bottle is a little small for the price and with little benefit except a bit of hydration, I will not repurchase.

I love the light texture and feel of this rice wine toner, and the fact that it doesn't make my skin tingle like other toners with alcohol in them. I haven't noticed a softening effect so much yet, after several weeks of use. It's a good, gentle toner to balance the skin.

This is an extremely refreshing neutral toner! I use it most frequently because I feel like it's the most neutral as far as moisturizing vs. exfoliating. It does give you a wonderful glow. Excellent toner.
I'm very pleased with this toner! It is by far the best toner I have ever tried. It leaves my face well moisturized!
Skin feels super soft and hydrated with this toner! I use it right after cleansing, before serum and all that jazz.
Loooove this stuff! Makes my skin feel so hydrated after every use. I'm so happy with every product I've bought from Peach&Lily. Love this brand!

avis.titre: Very hydrating and refreshing for dry skin
avis.texte: This is such a wonderful product for my dry skin. After doing all of my other skin prep, putting this on before using my glass skin veil serum helps calm my skin down and is a key in my makeup routine.
loved it goes well with the rest of my peach and lily skin care !

avis.titre: Great addition to my facial regimen
avis.texte: This toner is great and it does not dry out my skin. Keeps it feeling soft and clean.

I love turing this toner upside down and watching the "mother" blend into the rest of the product. Smells like sake. The texture has body to it, not too thin or thick. My skin feels deeply nourished. Softness for days. I enjoy this in the winter time.

I really like this toner. It is light, hydrating, and gentle on my skin. After using for a few weeks, my skin does feel softer and calmer with the really dry air and fires going on. I had actually stopped using toners for a while because they would be too harsh, too drying, or irritating in general but decided to give this one a try since it was new and I was interested in exploring the brand. I'm glad I did and plan on keeping this in my routine. I especially appreciate that it comes in a glass bottle to limit plastic waste.
I love what this does for my skin! It has taken away my tiny little bumps and gives my skin an overall smooth look!

I absolutely LOVE this softening toner! It leaves my skin feeling supple hydrated plump and extremely soothing and smooth! I have noticed a huge difference and improvement in my skin softness and glow without feeling tightnesses or dehydration! Definitely will be ordering more and I highly recommend for sensitive skin it works wonders! 10/10 🍑🍑:grinning_face_with_star_eyes:🩷🩷🩷
I use this after their scrub. It leaves my face really hydrated. Also it's helping me with my acne which is a plus. Really gentle and hydrating.

My skin has been really dried this winter & has been feeling really tight. I was recommended the bio rice toner & it is AMAZING! I can just use a cleanser and the bio rice toner and my face feels really hydrated and not tight at all!

My skin has been really dried this winter & has been feeling really tight. I was recommended the bio rice toner & it is AMAZING! I can just use a cleanser and the bio rice toner and my face feels really hydrated and not tight at all!
It's ok. Won't purchase again. I have not noticed any difference in my skin and I pretty much use it on a daily basis.
This product is fantastic, it's conditioning and at the same time extremely nourishing and toning! We definitely need a Jumbo size please !!!
I love this toner. Leaves my skin feeling soft and even-toned.

avis.titre: Great addition to my skin care
avis.texte: I have noticed the softness to my face in the past 3 weeks I've been using it. It hasn't broken me out. I like it more than my previous toner.

I was excited to try this and I think I've found my new toner. It has a slightly sharp scent from the rice wine, but it leaves me skin very soft without leaving a tacky layer on my skin. Skin toner looks even after consistent use. You have to shake it before each use because the particles separate.
I'm so glad I found peach and lily. I'm never using anything else again.
I'm not sure if this is the correct toner for me, but it does seem to soften the skin. Mixes well with other products. I use it daily.
Love the container and the feel of the product. The smell is definitely strong. .
My face feels even more amazing since I added this to my regimen.

avis.titre: Bio Rice Wine Is A Softening Toner
avis.texte: I sometimes find toners feel harsh on my combination skin but the Bio Rice Wine Softening Toner is a game changer. Give it a good shake, pat it on and my skin instantly feels soft and looks matte. I use this one everyday!
I love this toner. It feels so nice on the skin (it isn't thick or slimy), and I really feel like it helped with hydration and soothing irritation.
Very refreshing and light on your skin love it :heart_eyes: soft and gentle
